# Browser terminal assets

Bundled from the official npm packages `@xterm/xterm@5.5.0` and
`@xterm/addon-fit@0.10.0`, and `@xterm/addon-web-links@0.11.0`.
Package archives were verified against the registry's SHA-512 integrity
metadata. All use the MIT license included in `LICENSE`.

Source and documentation: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
These local files let the terminal load without a browser connection to a CDN.
